rule: The implementation control loop is the governance loop. Customer Service Work has its own business state machine and must never be conflated with implementation Work Orders or Zeck Executions.
completionRule: A Work Order is complete only after implementation evidence, required proofs, Architect approval, merge, and post-merge canonical-state finalization.
postMergeFinalization: A merge without canonical state reconciliation is a detected red window, not complete program state.
aiRule: All AI execution capabilities are delegated to Zeck; ServiceOS owns only business-domain consequences and deterministic business authority.
